component.name: LotusKey
Bộ gõ tiếng Việt LotusKey
component.summary: Native Vietnamese Input Method Engine for Linux (IBus / Fcitx5 / UInput)
Bộ gõ tiếng Việt tốc độ cao cho Linux (Wayland & X11)

description.p: LotusKey is a high-performance native Vietnamese input method engine for Linux supporting Wayland and X11 across GNOME, KDE Plasma, XFCE, Cinnamon, MATE, Hyprland, Sway, Cosmic, and standalone Window Managers.
LotusKey là bộ gõ tiếng Việt hiệu năng cao cho Linux, tương thích hoàn toàn với Wayland và X11 trên GNOME, KDE Plasma, XFCE, Cinnamon, MATE, Hyprland, Sway, Cosmic và các Window Manager độc lập.

ul.li: Multi-backend architecture: Native IBus C engine, Fcitx5 synchronization, Fcitx4 support, and Universal Evdev/UInput kernel daemon.
Supports Telex, VNI, and combined Telex + VNI typing methods.
Output charsets: Unicode (NFC), Unicode Combining (NFD), TCVN3 (ABC), and VNI Windows.
Smart bilingual spell-check, macro expansion with automatic case matching, quick consonant rules, and clipboard charset converter.
Flat national flag icons (VN/US/UK), modernVN/EN badges, Lotus emblem, and symbolic monochrome tray icons.

description.p: Full aarch64 (ARM64) architecture support with portable C-ABI source compilation engine, 2-tier submenu & dropdown UX, and comprehensive cross-distro packaging.
Multi-distro packaging expansion, flat flag SVG status icons (VN/US/UK), login autostart orchestrator, and IBus 1.5 ABI stability fixes.
